AMENDED AND RESTATED BYLAWS
OF
NORTHWIND HOLDINGS, INC.
(Adopted March 14, 2022; Amended June 3, 2024)

ARTICLE I — OFFICES
1.1 Registered Office. The registered office of the Corporation shall be as set forth in the Certificate of Incorporation.
1.2 Other Offices. The Corporation may have such other offices, either within or without Delaware, as the Board of Directors may from time to time designate.

ARTICLE II — STOCKHOLDERS
2.1 Annual Meeting. The annual meeting of the stockholders shall be held on the second Tuesday of May of each year, or such other date as the Board may designate.
2.2 Special Meetings. Special meetings of the stockholders may be called by the Board of Directors, the Chairperson, or holders of not less than 25% of the outstanding voting stock.
2.3 Notice. Written notice stating the place, date and hour of the meeting shall be given not less than 10 nor more than 60 days before the date of the meeting.
2.4 Quorum. A majority of the outstanding shares entitled to vote, present in person or represented by proxy, shall constitute a quorum.
2.5 Action Without a Meeting. Any action required or permitted to be taken at any meeting of stockholders may be taken without a meeting by written consent signed by holders of the minimum number of votes that would be necessary to authorize such action at a meeting, in accordance with DGCL § 228.

ARTICLE III — BOARD OF DIRECTORS
3.1 Number. The number of directors shall be not less than three (3) and not more than nine (9), the exact number to be fixed by resolution of the Board.
3.2 Election. Directors shall be elected at the annual meeting of stockholders to serve until the next annual meeting or until their successors are duly elected and qualified.
3.3 Vacancies. Vacancies on the Board may be filled by a majority of the remaining directors.
3.4 Regular and Special Meetings. Regular meetings shall be held at least quarterly. Special meetings may be called on 48 hours' notice by the Chairperson or any two directors.
3.5 Quorum. A majority of the total number of directors shall constitute a quorum.
3.6 Action Without a Meeting. Any action of the Board may be taken without a meeting by unanimous written consent, in accordance with DGCL § 141(f).
3.7 Committees. The Board may designate committees, including an Audit Committee and a Compensation Committee.

ARTICLE IV — OFFICERS
4.1 Officers. The officers shall be a Chief Executive Officer, a President, a Chief Financial Officer, and a Secretary, and such other officers as the Board may from time to time designate.
4.2 Appointment. Officers shall be appointed by the Board.
4.3 Removal. Any officer may be removed by the Board with or without cause.

ARTICLE V — INDEMNIFICATION
5.1 Right to Indemnification. Each person who was or is made a party to any threatened, pending, or completed action, suit, or proceeding by reason of the fact that such person is or was a director or officer of the Corporation shall be indemnified to the fullest extent permitted by DGCL § 145.
5.2 Advancement of Expenses. Expenses incurred by an indemnitee in defending any such proceeding shall be advanced by the Corporation upon receipt of an undertaking to repay if it shall ultimately be determined that such person is not entitled to indemnification.

ARTICLE VI — STOCK
6.1 Certificates. Shares may be represented by certificates or may be uncertificated.
6.2 Transfers. Transfers of stock shall be recorded on the books of the Corporation.

ARTICLE VII — AMENDMENTS
These Bylaws may be amended or repealed by the Board of Directors or by the stockholders.

CERTIFICATION
The undersigned Secretary certifies that the foregoing Bylaws were adopted by the Board of Directors on March 14, 2022 and amended on June 3, 2024.
/s/ Marcus D. Trelawney, Secretary
